episodeTitle.en: The ultimate guide to A/B testing | Ronny Kohavi (Airbnb, Microsoft, Amazon)
episodeTitle.zh: 《A/B测试终极指南》| 罗尼·科哈维（Airbnb、微软、亚马逊）

guestBioOfficial.en: Ronny Kohavi, PhD, is a consultant, teacher, and leading expert on the art and science of A/B testing. Previously, Ronny was Vice President and Technical Fellow at Airbnb, Technical Fellow and corporate VP at Microsoft (where he led the Experimentation Platform team), and Director of Data Mining and Personalization at Amazon. He was also honored with a lifetime achievement award by the Experimentation Culture Awards in September 2020 and teaches a popular course on experimentation on Maven. In today’s podcast, we discuss: • How to foster a culture of experimentation
guestBioOfficial.zh:
罗尼·科哈维（Ronny Kohavi）博士是一位顾问、教师，也是A/B测试艺术与科学领域的顶尖专家。此前，他曾担任爱彼迎（Airbnb）的副总裁兼技术研究员、微软的技术研究员兼企业副总裁（领导实验平台团队），以及亚马逊的数据挖掘与个性化主管。2020年9月，他荣获实验文化奖的终身成就奖，并在Maven平台上开设了热门的实验课程。在今天的播客中，我们将讨论：  
• 如何培育实验文化

title.en: The ultimate guide to A/B testing | Ronny Kohavi (Airbnb, Microsoft, Amazon)
title.zh: 《A/B测试终极指南》| 罗尼·科哈维（Airbnb、微软、亚马逊）

summary.en: Ronny makes the case for 'test everything,' sharing the famous Bing story where moving one search line increased revenue by ~12% ($100M) and the Airbnb new-tab experiment. He explains why most predictions about experiments are humblingly wrong, how to build a culture of trustworthy experimentation, and why trust is the most important element of a successful program. The episode is a tactical masterclass on running experiments that actually move metrics.
summary.zh: Ronny 力主“凡事皆测试”，分享了著名的 Bing 案例——仅仅移动一行搜索结果就带来约 12%（1 亿美元）的营收增长——以及 Airbnb 新标签页实验。他解释了为什么我们对实验结果的预测常常错得离谱，如何建立可信实验的文化，以及为什么“信任”是成功实验体系中最关键的要素。本期是关于运行真正能撬动指标的实验的实战大师课。
